ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: K-Bap uses the camera to scan menus, take photos for your reviews, and set your profile picture.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: K-Bap accesses your photos so you can scan a saved menu, add photos to reviews and posts, set a profile picture, or attach them to an inquiry.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save your K-Bap story card to your photo library.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: K-Bap uses your location to find nearby restaurants, so you can tag a place in a review and record where you ate.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: K-Bap uses motion to notice when your phone is turned sideways while you scan a menu.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: K-Bap uses your device identifier to show ads that are more relevant to you and to measure how they perform.
